description: Sat, and did not count the sand.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Put the loaf on the board and did not ask.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Came with the house, and was not asked where he is from.
name: Gillis Verbeke

description: Sat in his pew. He did not speak.
name: Sir John Spencer

description: Said he would be brief, turned the glass twice, and was not brief.
name: Master Josias Thwaite

description: Ate, and left the coffer shut.
name: William Shakespeare
